test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.

The man had committed a __grave__ offence so he was granted bail.
solution:
The correct answer is: **trivial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"grave"** means serious or important, often used to describe situations, actions, or conditions with significant consequences. (गंभीर)
 
 
• **Example:** The judge emphasized the grave consequences of breaking the law.
 
 
 
• **"Trivial"** refers to something that is unimportant or insignificant, lacking seriousness or weight. (तुच्छ)
 
 
• **Example:** The argument started over a trivial matter and quickly escalated unnecessarily.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'grave'** is **'trivial'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **trivial**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Dignified** (गरिमामय): Exhibiting an air of respect or seriousness.
 
 
• **Example:** She handled the challenging situation in a dignified manner.
 
 
 
• **Serious** (गंभीर): Demanding careful consideration or attention; not joking.
 
 
• **Example:** The doctor gave him a serious warning about his health condition.
 
 
 
• **Solemn** (गंभीर): Formal and dignified, often used to describe occasions or expressions.
 
 
• **Example:** The ceremony was a solemn event, filled with meaningful traditions.
